Relying on sase-zt.5's prior closed-bead live-admission evidence (queue_capacity=100 admitted over a lowered limit, queue_capacity=1 parked with an insufficient-capacity blocker) plus (2) above and the real-scan tests in test_run_agent_runner_slot_scan_capacity.py for this phase's live/authored-vs-rendered requirement.
